items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well, I had put Saeed in my place before I left, see?

ctx.x: That's all I wondered, you know? I thought maybe some mistake that you really weren't there. I didn't know if you were there with him.

Yeah, I was there with him. And so Doc gave him my money and all. And so I came on down to Los Angeles. Well, I had put Saeed in my place before I left, see? I had to ship my drums off to New Orleans. And I stopped at the Beverly Cabin the night that they was working there. So Saeed asked me if I wanted my job back. I said, Saeed, I didn't come back here to look for my job back. I said, I'm just passed through on my way home. He said, well, you know, I'm in the civil service and my wife got a letter for me and…
Yeah, that's what I hear. They closed.
